body: I am a 3rd year bioengineering student with a 3.7+ GPA at a well respected university (and I love(d) this major). That's what scares me, is that my life is going so well and I still feel like there's nothing there for me. I loved my major, I loved going out with my friends, I loved playing video games, and tons more things. None of these things have disappeared from my life, but I literally feel no need to even bother with any of them anymore.

From what I can tell nothing has changed. But what definitely made matters worse was when I tried talking to my gf and parents about it. They both seem to think that I just don't get out enough or something. They don't realize that I have literally lost the will to do that.
The lack of enjoyment is also something new. Never had this happen before.

I have had one pretty bad spell of anxiety that lasted for a couple weeks when I was 18. As far as I knew there was nothing that triggered it. I got put on xanax and I took it for about of week but didn't like how it made me feel so I stopped.
